statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n h : ℕ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(h:ℝ)*t))) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let A := fun (n h : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1-h), a k * a (k+h); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ (F : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), (F.card:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((L n:ℝ)/16) → (∀ k ≤ n, |a k| ≤ 4*(1+Real.log (n:ℝ))) → (∑ h ∈ F, |A n h a * V n h|) ≤ ε*(n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 任意位置的稀疏间距集只贡献 o(n)
plain_statement.en: Arbitrarily located sparse lag sets contribute sublinearly

brief.zh: 间距集与权可以随 n 改变。用指数面积界证明 |F|² 乘以异常集面积至多为一，再以四次对数的面积衰减吸收平方后的权。可剔除分散的例外间距，仍需估计剩下的稠密偶间距。
brief.en: The set and weights may depend on n. The exponential area bound pays for the squared cardinality. Logarithmic area decay absorbs the remaining squared weight. This controls scattered exceptions while leaving the dense even-lag sum open.
